# ShadowTalk AI

> ShadowTalk AI is a privacy-first agentic AI workspace. It runs autonomous multi-step missions, ships 30+ specialized tools (chat, code, voice, vision, deep research, image generation, security audit), and supports fully offline on-device models via WebGPU.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of ShadowTalk AI, the agentic workspace.
- [Chatbot](/chatbot): Conversational AI with 10+ specialized modes, voice, vision, and tool use.
- [Mission Control](/missioncontrol): Launch and monitor autonomous multi-step AI missions.
- [Deep Research](/research): SERP-grounded multi-step research with cited synthesis.
- [Strategy Agent](/strategy): AI business intelligence, market and competitor analysis.
- [Workspace](/workspace): Collaborative AI workspace for teams and projects.
- [Creative Studio](/studio): AI media editor for images, documents, and creative output.
- [Presentation Builder](/presentations): Auto-generate slides and decks from a prompt.
- [Code IDE](/ide): In-browser Monaco IDE with AI-assisted coding and live preview.

- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Browse and install specialized AI agents and plugins.
- [Cyber Command](/cyber): Cybersecurity operations center with 8 integrated modules.
